name: repo-guidance
description: Navigate the Composio SDK monorepo, branch and PR workflow, repo layout, generated-file boundaries, changesets, and shared maintenance rules. Use when work spans multiple packages, when deciding where code belongs, when preparing a PR, or when the user asks about repository conventions rather than a specific SDK implementation.
author: ComposioHQ
summary_zh: 面向 Composio SDK 多包仓库的开发协作指南，适合跨包改动、代码归属判断、提交 PR 及了解仓库规范。
